caption: Discovery
description: The OASF skills and domains of an artifact, without the record around them, so that other formats can embed them as an extension. In an A2A Agent Card, the payload is the params of an AgentExtension whose uri is <schema_url>/<version>/objects/discovery on the schema server the payload validates against, for example https://schema.oasf.outshift.com/1.2.0/objects/discovery. In an AI Catalog entry, it is the value of the org.agntcy.oasf.discovery.v1 key in the entry's extensions map. The schema_version in the payload is the version that counts; a version in the A2A URI is informational.
name: discovery

schema_version.caption: Schema Version
schema_version.description: The version of the OASF schema the payload conforms to.

skills.caption: Skills
skills.description: List of skills associated with the artifact.

domains.caption: Domains
domains.description: List of domains associated with the artifact.
